title: elisanthe noctiflora
intro: Elisanthe noctiflora, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant native to North America. The plant is rich in gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid that has been associated with various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving skin health, and supporting cardiovascular well-being. The therapeutic actions of Elisanthe noctiflora include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, making it a popular natural remedy for conditions such as eczema, arthritis, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of the plant include GLA, as well as other polyphenols, flavonoids, and phenolic acids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
